content.text:
I submitted **index 6 (Sb fraction 0.10)** as the best composition. It had the highest EQE of the five I measured, at 0.050%. I can't rule out a slightly better composition nearby, because I didn't measure indices 5 or 7.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0.057 | 0.037 |
| **6** | **0.101** | **0.050** |
| 8 | 0.124 | 0.045 |
| 15 | 0.259 (near Y₃SbO₇) | 0.036 |
| 24 | 0.516 (near YSbO₄) | 0.035 |

- **Where the peak is:** EQE is highest around Sb 0.10 and drops off both below it and at higher Sb.
- **XRD:** I used 3 of 5 XRD measurements. At indices 4 and 6, the patterns show only peaks that match the Pt substrate. By index 9 (Sb 0.14), a new film peak appears at Q ≈ 2.07 Å⁻¹, which suggests the film starts to crystallize there. EQE is already falling by then.
- **The Gaussian-process suggestion:** it recommended the Sb-rich end (index 20). I didn't follow it, because it picked that region only for lack of data. The measurements fall steadily with more Sb, so that end is unlikely to beat index 6.

All 5 EQE measurements are used.
